title.zh: Shopify moves back to Native from React Native
title.en: Shopify moves back to Native from React Native

current_state.zh: Shopify has migrated its mobile app from React Native back to fully native iOS and Android code, citing better platform optimization and the changing economics of native development, with HN commenters sharing similar migrations and debating when cross-platform frameworks still make sense.
